title: wrapping at a narrow width, preformatted text and wide characters

program.name: wrap
program.description:
A long description of the program that goes on and on so that it has to be wrapped at the help width.

A second paragraph after a blank line.

arguments.name: <input>
arguments.description: An argument with a description that is long enough to wrap onto more lines.

options.description: The term is wider than the others.

Preformatted:
  indented line one
  indented line two
Arrows → and emoji 📷 count as JavaScript counts them, a character or two each, when wrapping.
Several   spaces   between   words   that   wrap   here   and   there   again.

cases.stdout:
Usage: wrap [options] <input>

A long description of the program that goes on and
on so that it has to be wrapped at the help width.

A second paragraph after a blank line.

Arguments:
  input                                     An argument with a description that is long enough to wrap onto more lines.

Options:
  --a-very-long-option-name-indeed <value>  The term is wider than the others.
  --short                                   Short description.
  --pre                                     Preformatted:
    indented line one
    indented line two
  --unicode                                 Arrows → and emoji 📷 count as JavaScript counts them, a character or two each, when wrapping.
  --spaces                                  Several   spaces   between   words   that   wrap   here   and   there   again.
  --no-desc
  -h, --help                                display help for command
